x: Conditions were not improved when mid-way through the season we lost the services of Steve Gibson, one of our most promising high jumpers who went into hospital for an operation on an old war wound.
Again we seem to be short of High Jumpers but things will not be so bad if our Champion Eddie Mackenzie and Steve Gibson can turn out regularly.

Steve Gibson will be available again, together with Nick Nickini, who showed promise before going into the Forces. In the Long Jump and Hop, Step and Jump it looks as if we shall have some better performances than since 1939.
